instructions.step_1: Send an email to support@pawpeers.com with the subject 'Facebook Data Deletion Request'.
instructions.step_2: Include your full name and the email associated with your Facebook account.
instructions.step_3: PawPeer will verify your request and confirm data deletion within 7 business days.
instructions.alternative: Alternatively, you can remove PawPeer from your connected apps in Facebook settings to trigger an automatic data deletion callback.
